title: UVM texture extensions
description: UV_texture_color_key. Attaches to a glTF texture's `extensions`; the image bytes stay as the source stored them (SPEC_UVM §11.6).

color.description: The key's stored 8-bit RGB, compared before colour conversion, filtering or mipmap generation.

tolerance.description: Largest per-channel difference that still matches; 0 is an exact match.
